title: Build an app from the dashboard

scenes.title: Build and test a preview from the dashboard
scenes.caption: The outcome is a working app with a tested filter, not just generated HTML or a screenshot.
scenes.label: REAL DASHBOARD CAPTURE

scenes.title: No local CLI or SDK is needed
scenes.caption: Dashboard controls manage the workspace. OpenCode writes the app; Harakiri supplies terminal, files, routes and cleanup.
scenes.label: THE DASHBOARD / NO LOCAL TOOLCHAIN

steps.title: Your browser
steps.detail: Create a workspace. Use Terminal, Filesystem and Network. Check results before cleanup.

steps.title: Harakiri sandbox
steps.detail: OpenCode generates server.mjs and index.html. Node serves the app on port 3000.

steps.title: External model
steps.detail: Only the explicit free model is configured. The provider receives synthetic task context.

scenes.title: Create a workspace from the OpenCode template
scenes.caption: Use the OpenCode template. Add model configuration before Create sandbox; do not paste a Harakiri API key into the form.
scenes.label: REAL DASHBOARD CAPTURE

scenes.title: Set the model configuration before creating
scenes.caption: Select Create sandbox. Wait for running and for Terminal to report attached before sending commands.
scenes.label: REPRODUCTION COMMANDS / SEE COMPLETE TUTORIAL

scenes.title: The full prompt: application behavior
scenes.caption: Three synthetic releases, a real select filter, a health endpoint, and Node standard library only.
scenes.label: ui-prompt.txt / COMPLETE PROMPT / PART 1 OF 2
scenes.content: Build a working release status dashboard in /workspace with only Node standard library, no npm dependencies. Create server.mjs and index.html. Serve on 0.0.0.0:3000. GET /health must return JSON {"ok":true}. The page title and h1 must be Release board. Include three release rows with data-status: Portal passed, Search running, Billing queued. Add a select with id status-filter and options All, passed, running, queued; selecting an option must hide nonmatching rows.

scenes.title: The full prompt: quality and execution
scenes.caption: OpenCode must write files and execute tools. It must leave the server stopped so you control when the preview starts.
scenes.label: ui-prompt.txt / COMPLETE PROMPT / PART 2 OF 2
scenes.content: Use a professional white layout, dark text, a small red brand accent, green/amber status indicators, clear headings, and responsive spacing. Add a count in #visible-count that updates with the visible rows. Test syntax with node --check server.mjs. Do not leave the server running. Use your tools to write the files and test them.

scenes.title: Paste the complete command into Terminal
scenes.caption: The command runs remotely. Do not close or kill the sandbox while the agent is writing files.
scenes.label: DASHBOARD TERMINAL / COMPLETE COPYABLE COMMAND
scenes.content: cd /workspace && opencode run --format json --model opencode/mimo-v2.5-free 'Build a working release status dashboard in /workspace with only Node standard library, no npm dependencies. Create server.mjs and index.html. Serve on 0.0.0.0:3000. GET /health must return JSON {"ok":true}. The page title and h1 must be Release board. Include three release rows with data-status: Portal passed, Search running, Billing queued. Add a select with id status-filter and options All, passed, running, queued; selecting an option must hide nonmatching rows. Use a professional white layout, dark text, a small red brand accent, green/amber status indicators, clear headings, and responsive spacing. Add a count in #visible-count that updates with the visible rows. Test syntax with node --check server.mjs. Do not leave the server running. Use your tools to write the files and test them.' > agent.jsonl 2>&1

scenes.title: Inspect tool activity and model costs
scenes.caption: The recording contains completed file-writing and bash tools. Completed model steps reported cost 0.
scenes.label: REAL DASHBOARD CAPTURE

scenes.title: Inspect the files the agent actually created
scenes.caption: Both requested files exist. A success message without files is not an accepted result.
scenes.label: REAL DASHBOARD CAPTURE

scenes.title: Check and start the Node server
scenes.caption: Syntax passes and local health returns {"ok":true}. The app listens on 0.0.0.0:3000 for the route to reach it.
scenes.label: REPRODUCTION COMMANDS / SEE COMPLETE TUTORIAL
scenes.content:
cd /workspace && node --check server.mjs
cd /workspace && nohup node server.mjs > server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/health

scenes.title: Expose only the application port
scenes.caption: Port 3000, HTTP, Public. The generated preview /health returned HTTP 200 and {"ok":true} in the capture.
scenes.label: NETWORK / VERIFIED PUBLIC PREVIEW
scenes.content:
Port       3000
Protocol   HTTP
Access     Public
Health     200 / {"ok":true}

Only the app port is exposed.

scenes.title: Exercise the filter in the real preview
scenes.caption: Passed displays Portal only. All restores Portal, Search and Billing. Test behavior, not appearance alone.
scenes.label: REAL DASHBOARD CAPTURE

scenes.title: Terminate and verify the preview is gone
scenes.caption: The UI Kill action terminated the recorded runtime, and the public route stopped serving the application.
scenes.label: REAL DASHBOARD CAPTURE
